app.title: Strafe: A new open-source, E2E Encrypted, and federated alternative to Discord
app.author: brydencalaway
app.description: Strafe is an open‑source, end‑to‑end encrypted, federated chat platform that serves as a privacy‑focused alternative to Discord.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run docker compose up to launch a local instance
Send a message via the REST API and verify it appears in the UI
Measure end‑to‑end latency for a 1KB message
Check that the server rejects unauthenticated connections
